question: A company manufactures two kinds of products, M and N. Each unit of M requires 2 hours of machine time and 3 hours of labor, while N requires 3 hours of machine and 2 hours of labor. Max 18 hours of machine and 24 hours of labor are available per day. The profit per M is Rs 80, per N is Rs 100. Set up the LPP, graph, find all corner points and the maximum profit.

options.A: Produce 0 units of M and 6 units of N; maximum profit Rs 600.
options.B: Produce 7.2 units of M and 1.2 units of N; maximum profit Rs 696.
options.C: Produce 8 units of M and 0 units of N; maximum profit Rs 640.
options.D: Produce 9 units of M and 0 units of N; maximum profit Rs 720.
